scope: Local exact namesake follow-up, 19 December 2026–1 March 2027 inclusive, LV/LT/EE. The interval contains 73 civil dates and excludes 29 February because 2027 is not a leap year. Histories and labelled hypotheses remain unchanged.

people.method: Reconciled every under-five profile against the saved national-title results and completed country/prominence checks from rounds 117–124; no broad national Wikipedia/Wikidata run was restarted. Searched the private cache for 163 selected name strings before targeted institutional/professional searches. The corrected Antonia and Ande calendar entries had no separate prefix search: only those two new exact-form searches were run. All new biographies were opened and saved through the source-cache tool. Sources/provenance are not displayed as widget citations.
